findings.heading: Using helper functions for filtering / Sử dụng hàm trợ giúp để lọc
findings.proposition: The English says `%between%` matches NUMERIC columns within a prespecified range; the Vietnamese says it matches "các cột theo số thứ tự" (columns by ordinal/sequence number) within a prespecified range.
findings.reader_consequence: A Vietnamese reader can conclude `%between%` selects a range of column POSITIONS rather than filtering rows on a numeric column's values, which contradicts the adjacent code `linelist[age %between% c(40, 60)]`; they may try `%between%` for column-index selection and get an error or wrong subset.

findings.heading: Resources / Tài nguyên học liệu
findings.proposition: The English gives the cheat-sheet URL as https://s3.amazonaws.com/assets.datacamp.com/blog_assets/datatable_Cheat_Sheet_R.pdf; the Vietnamese displays it as .../datatable_Cheat_Shgiteet_R.pdf, a URL that does not exist (only the hidden href is correct).
findings.reader_consequence: A Vietnamese reader who reads or copies the visible URL (from print, PDF, or by typing it) reaches a dead address and cannot get the cheat sheet.
